title: Jamaican Skillet Delight
description: A flavorful and vegetarian skillet dish inspired by Jamaican spices. This recipe combines the crunch of crispy bacon with the sweetness of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped bacon and cook until crispy.
Add the diced tomatoes, jerk seasoning, and skillet potatoes.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
